Catalyst-junkie, perma-bull, rate-hawk and value-guy pay Canada versus the US because CA-US_2Y at -140.0bp is a 1y 3.77th / 5y 4.31st percentile cheap tail; value-guy states USDCAD is only moderately rich; catalyst-junkie records USDCAD versus CA-US_2Y as weak (r_squared 0.022). attack: USD contaminates the CAD argument. VERIFIED FACT: the Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 Sep with futures >90% priced. That impulse sits in both AUDUSD and USDCAD, which is why those pairs look ordinary while AUDCAD is maxed on the 252-observation screen. Long USDCAD as a CAD_DOWN expression owns the Fed residual, not Australia versus Canada.

Carry does not rescue CAD_DOWN. VERIFIED FACT: the carry screen ranks long AUD / short CAD first at 164.9bp over 4.93 vol and long USD / short CAD second at 140.0bp; both series are 2Y sovereign differential / 60d FX vol, not forward carry. That is CAD-as-funding in USD space and in the cross. The FX-versus-rates gap is that AUDCAD is a 5y extreme while CA-AU 2Y is only median; fading CAD via USDCAD fights a 140bp US-CA gap that is already a cheap CA-US_2Y tail, whereas short AUDCAD fades an ordinary AU-CA yield gap that spot has already overshot.

The 17 Sep CA 2Y -8bp / CA 10Y -9bp dip is the exact class of 1-day print trend-follower refuses to treat as invalidation on US 2Y. Using it to tag CAD_DOWN is the premature reversal they claim to reject. INFERENCE: a 1-day Canada rates rally after a +31bp 1m backup is not a CAD-lower regime.
